_about: Rates and quotas read from official AWS AgentCore pages on 2026-10-21. They change: re-verify before budgeting or capacity commitments. Region coverage for Policy is a third-party snapshot (July 2026) — confirm on the official supported-Regions page.

smithy.note: No privateEndpoint; open a Support case for private connectivity.

api_gateway.note: Regional REST only; private APIs not supported as targets — export as OpenAPI target with routingDomain instead. No OAuth outbound, no cross-account.

openapi.note: privateEndpoint via VPC Lattice covers one domain; multi-domain needs Support (privateEndpointOverrides).

mcp_server.note: Supports 3LO, elicitation, sampling, streaming. Inventory prompts/resources: Policy evaluates MCP tools only.

lambda.note: Reach VPC resources with a VPC-attached function; you author the tool schema.

runtime.note: Backbone; ensure the Runtime accepts only gateway-originated calls. Verify policy applicability for the route.

http_passthrough.note: No protocol translation; provide an API schema to enable policy/guardrail features; verify policy coverage.
